section.title: Beyond the Terminal
section.description: Outside work, I trade dashboards for ridgelines, terminal prompts for trail markers, and cloud systems for quiet wild places.

pursuits.title: Wildlife Photography
pursuits.subtitle: Patient frames from untamed places
pursuits.description: I look for small, honest moments in nature: movement, stillness, light, texture, and the quiet personality of wildlife.

pursuits.title: Nature Trails
pursuits.subtitle: Long walks with better signal
pursuits.description: Hiking gives me space to reset, observe, and keep curiosity alive away from screens and production alerts.

pursuits.title: Open-Air Exploration
pursuits.subtitle: Following weather, maps, and instinct
pursuits.description: I enjoy exploring forests, coastlines, mountain tracks, and everyday corners that become interesting when you slow down.
